items.title: Russia escalates dispute with Apple over mandatory app preinstallation
items.summary: Reuters reports that Russia's antitrust regulator has opened a formal case against Apple over the company's failure to preinstall the state-backed MAX messenger and Russia's RuStore app marketplace on its devices. Here are the details.

items.title: Apple caps security bug reports amid surge in AI-generated findings

items.title: Judge greenlights multi-billion-dollar class action over Apple Photos' face recognition
